remarks:
Exceptional investment opportunity in the heart of Bemus Point! This charming historic property offers multiple vacation rental accommodations just one block from beautiful Chautauqua Lake, making it an ideal destination for lake enthusiasts, vacationers, and investors alike.
This residence features 6 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms (4 units), comfortably accommodating families and groups seeking a relaxing lakeside getaway. Guests can enjoy a short walk to local shops, restaurants, and attractions, while the nearby public boat ramp is only three blocks away. Long Point State Park’s sandy beach is just 2 miles from the property, offering swimming and waterfront recreation.
In addition to the main residence, the property includes a beautifully appointed studio rental featuring inviting décor, a dedicated workspace for remote professionals, a private porch, and a cozy gas fire pit perfect for evening relaxation. The studio’s warm ambiance complements the tranquil lakeside setting and appeals to both short-term vacationers and extended-stay guests.
Located near some of Western New York’s premier attractions, guests can explore the renowned Chautauqua Institution, enjoy performances and exhibits, visit the award-winning National Comedy Center, or take a nostalgic ride on the historic carousel at Midway State Park. With 4 total rental units on-site, this property offers tremendous flexibility for hosting larger groups, family reunions, wedding guests, or multiple vacationing families. Whether you’re seeking a turnkey vacation rental business, a mixed-use investment property, or a unique lakeside retreat, 15 Main Street delivers location, charm, and income-producing potential in one of Chautauqua County’s most desirable destinations.
Highlights:
Historic multi-unit vacation rental property
1 block from Chautauqua Lake
3 blocks to public boat launch
2 miles to Long Point State Park beach
Walking distance to village attractions
Four rental units for maximum income potential
Private porches and outdoor gathering areas
Ideal for vacation rentals, family gatherings, and investment purposes
Near Chautauqua Institution, National Comedy Center, and Midway State Park
